scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' && .venv/bin/pip install pytest ruff pre-commit && .venv/bin/pre-commit install && (cd frontend && npm install) && (cd config && npm install)
scripts.verification: bash -lc 'files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo "No changed files to verify"; exit 0; fi; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --files $files'

append_prompt:
## ZINC-FUSION-V15 Critical Rules

**BEFORE any code change:**
1. Read AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md fully
2. Run configured verification command (must exit 0 before claiming done)
3. Verify imports exist: .venv/bin/ruff check --select F821 <file>
4. Verify tables exist: check prisma/schema.prisma

**BANNED:**
- Inventing imports/functions/tables that don't exist
- Saying "I believe" or "probably" - cite file:line evidence
- Skipping verification
- Using banned schemas: raw, gold, silver, bronze, monitoring, specialist, weather, archive, vegas

**For complex tasks (3+ steps):**
Use .zenflow/workflows/full-sdd.md with STOP checkpoints at each phase.

available.name: Full SDD Workflow
available.description: Spec-Driven Development for complex tasks (3+ steps)

available.name: Fix Bug
available.description: Structured debugging with root cause analysis

pre_commit.command: bash -lc 'files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo "No changed files to verify"; exit 0; fi; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --files $files'

python.command: bash -lc 'files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT | grep -E "\\.py$" || true); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo "No changed Python files to lint"; exit 0; fi; .venv/bin/ruff check --select F401,F403,F405,F821,F841 $files'

requirements_complete.message: STOP: Review requirements.md before proceeding to spec

spec_complete.message: STOP: Review spec.md before proceeding to plan

implementation_complete.message: STOP: Run configured verification command and review all changes
implementation_complete.verification_command: bash -lc 'files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT); if [ -z "$files" ]; then echo "No changed files to verify"; exit 0; fi; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --files $files'
